claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive (ClassFeatureMechanics family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Druidic is not activated — it is an always-on feature that grants effects at class acquisition with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no rest reset. The current ClassFeatureMechanics union has only 'activation', which requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence. A 'passive' family is needed for features that simply grant ongoing effects when the class feature is acquired.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids. [...] you always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The 'grant_spell_access' atom exists in the v4 taxonomy but has no representation in ClassFeatureEffect (which only includes GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect). Druidic grants 'Speak with Animals' as always-prepared — a spell-access grant, not an action or heal. This variant is needed to encode the spell preparation side of the feature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared.
